CustomField.description: Open: needs a decision (the contract keeps its value; Needs Legal Review is set). Accepted: the new term governs - it is written to the contract and wins on every rebuild (for a flag: acknowledged). Rejected: the contract keeps its value (for a flag: acknowledged as wrong). Info: nothing to decide. A decision resets to Open if the deal's value changes.
CustomField.label: Status
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Mark Accepted or Rejected to decide; the contract is rebuilt with the decision in a minute.
